# MusicMute Web App

> MusicMute isolates vocals from audio to reduce background music and keep the voice. The web app is at https://app.music-mute.com/.

## Public pages

- [Web app](https://app.music-mute.com/): public introduction and account sign-in.
- [MusicMute](https://music-mute.com/): product information and app destinations.

## Web app capabilities

- Sign in or create an account with email or Google.
- Upload local audio or import a supported source link. The web app does not accept local video files.
- Follow processing updates, keep completed tracks in the online library, and play vocal audio.
- Use the English or Arabic interface. JavaScript and an account are required for app features.

## Limits and access

Only process audio you own or have permission to use. Supported links depend on source availability, service policy, and account limits. Separation quality varies with the original recording; perfect removal is not guaranteed.

Account, job, library, player, and settings pages require sign-in and are not public search content. This file describes public product capabilities only; it does not grant access to private audio or account data.
